raw:
The user wants UI strings for a file management app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). The concept is a "container" (容器) that users can create to organize things, and they can move items into it.

Requirements:
- s1: Button to create a new container
- s2: Status text after creation
- s3: Dialog title for moving an item

They want Taiwan Traditional Chinese UI terminology, not Mainland Chinese terms.

Common Taiwan UI conventions:
- 建立 (not 创建/創建 - 建立 is standard in Taiwan for "create")
- 新增 is also very common for "new/add"
- 按鈕 labels: often just "新增容器" or "建立新容器"
- Status text: "已建立容器" or "容器已建立"
- Dialog title for moving item: "移動項目" or "移動至容器" / "移至容器"

Taiwan terminology notes:
- 项目 → 項目 is actually fine in Taiwan, but in file management context, Taiwan often uses "項目" or "檔案", "項目" is used in Microsoft Taiwan UI (e.g., "選取項目"). Actually "項目" is used, but sometimes "項目" refers to "project" in some contexts. In Taiwan Microsoft terminology, "item" = "項目". So "移動項目" is fine. Alternatively "移動檔案" but the app says "項目".

Container: The user says "容器" (container). In Taiwan UI, "資料夾" is folder, but the user specifically said 容器, so I should use 容器.

s1: Button to create a new container → "新增容器" or "建立新容器". Buttons in Taiwan UI: "新增" is very common (e.g., 新增資料夾). I'd go with "新增容器" — simple button label. Or "建立新容器". Since s2 says "建立後的狀態文字", the create action word could be "建立". Taiwan apps commonly use "新增" for creating new items in buttons. Both acceptable. I'll pick "新增容器" for the button (concise) — actually "建立新容器" explicitly matches "create a new container". Buttons tend to be concise. Hmm. Let me think: "新增容器" is natural. But "建立新容器" is also fine. I'll go with "新增容器".

Actually, to be safe and match "建立一個新的容器", using "新增容器" is standard Taiwan UI. Google Drive Taiwan uses "新增資料夾". So "新增容器" follows that pattern.

s2: Status text after creation → "已建立容器" or "容器已建立" or "已新增容器". Common Taiwan UI status: "已建立「容器名稱」" but we don't have a variable. Simple: "容器已建立" or "已建立新容器". I'll use "已建立新容器" — matches that a new container was created. Or "容器建立成功". Taiwan style often "已新增" like "已新增1個項目". Since button says 新增, status could be "已新增容器" for consistency. Hmm, consistency: s1 "新增容器", s2 "已新增容器". But "已建立" also common. I'll keep consistent: "已新增容器" — actually status messages like "「XX」已建立" are common in Google Drive ("已建立資料夾"). Google Drive Taiwan shows "已建立資料夾". If button is 新增, message might be... Google Drive shows "Untitled folder 已建立". Apple iOS Files app in zh-TW: "新增資料夾" button, and confirmation? Hmm.

I'll go: s1 "新增容器", s2 "已建立新容器", s3 "移動項目".

For s3, dialog title for moving an item: "移動項目" or "移至容器" / "移動至容器". The dialog is for moving an item (into the container). "移動項目" is straightforward title. Or "移動至容器" which clarifies destination. Both fine. I'd say "移動項目" as the dialog title per request "移動項目的對話框標題". Could also be "移至新容器"? The context: they can move an item into it (the container). The dialog might be a picker to choose destination. Title "移動項目" is safe. Alternatively "選擇目的地" but that's beyond ask.

Taiwan vs China terminology check:
- 文件 vs 檔案: Taiwan uses 檔案 for files. Not used here.
- 对话框 → 對話框 (Taiwan) vs 對話方塊 (Microsoft Taiwan). Both used; "對話框" is fine and common.
- 移动 → 移動 (same).
- 创建 → 建立 (Taiwan). Good.
- 默认 etc. not used.

Output only JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.

Final:
{
  "s1": "新增容器",
  "s2": "已建立新容器",
  "s3": "移動項目"
}

Hmm, s2 consistency with "新增": maybe "已新增容器". But "已建立新容器" reads naturally. Either is fine. Let me consider: after creating the container, status text could show "「名稱」已建立" with placeholder. Since no placeholder mentioned, "已建立新容器" works. Actually to be more informative as a toast: "容器已建立" is also common pattern. I'll use "已建立新容器".

Wait — should s1 be "建立新容器"? The prompt says "建立新容器的按鈕" literally. But they said UI language Taiwan. "新增" is the dominant Taiwan term for create-new buttons. I'll stick with "新增容器". Actually let me reconsider: both Google (新增), Apple (新增), Microsoft (新增/建立). "新增" is safest.

s3: "移動項目" — good. Could enhance to "移動至容器" but plain "移動項目" matches the ask exactly.

Output only JSON, no extra text.</think>{
  "s1": "新增容器",
  "s2": "已建立新容器",
  "s3": "移動項目"
}
